row.evidence: Puppet Enterprise connects to SAML identity providers for SSO and to OpenLDAP or Active Directory read-only for users and groups; the PE documentation table of contents (1,302 topics) has no SCIM page, and Puppet Enterprise is priced by quote.
row.notes: Self-hosted infrastructure automation product priced per node by quote (Core: Developer free under 25 nodes, Commercial custom for 25+; Enterprise and Advanced: Contact Sales), so per-user fields stay null. No SCIM on any edition (none by absence, rule 5). Puppet Enterprise offers SAML SSO (Okta and ADFS guides) with attribute binding that maps IdP groups to PE user groups and roles at sign-in, plus read-only LDAP directory integration (OpenLDAP, Active Directory). The RBAC API on the PE console (port 4433) lists, creates, edits, deletes, revokes and reinstates users and assigns roles; the activity service API is the audit trail and supports callback subscriptions. Puppet Core has no console or RBAC.

scim.notes: No SCIM topic in the Puppet Enterprise docs TOC (1,302 topics); identity integration is SAML SSO and read-only LDAP. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: User authentication tokens (X-Authentication header) or allowed certificates; permissions follow RBAC roles.

endpoints.purpose: Get a list of all local and remote users
Delete a user from the PE console
Fetch information about all user groups
Create a remote directory user group
Fetch information about all user roles

events: activity service callback subscriptions (RBAC entity changes: users, directory groups, user roles)

user_api.notes: Self-hosted: the RBAC API runs on the customer's PE console host. api_tax left null because Puppet Core has no console users or RBAC at all.

okta.notes: No OIN page at okta.com/integrations/puppet/ or /puppet-enterprise/; Puppet documents a custom Okta SAML app.

entra.notes: No Puppet entry in the Entra saas-apps tutorial list (toc.json), so row.idp.entra is none.

fallbacks.other_sync: Read-only LDAP directory integration (OpenLDAP, Active Directory); SAML group attribute maps IdP groups to PE user groups and roles at sign-in
